description: The web guard on a 375 px phone: viewer with the probe's Guest role on a 375x812 touch screen (html.layout-mobile). The drawer (opened with its header button; the edge swipe opens the same drawer) has no Settings link; the header's user button leads to the Settings menu with Sign out and the note; a typed locked URL ends on Home. Reads only.

steps.name: the guard has viewer's /Me (every section locked) in the mobile layout
open the drawer
steps.script: const b = document.querySelector('.mainDrawerButton'); if (b) b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1200)); return !!b;

steps.name: the drawer has no Settings link
steps.assert: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('.mainDrawer .btnSettings') || document.querySelector('a.navMenuOption[data-itemid="settings"]'); return __vars.drawer === true && (!s || getComputedStyle(s).display === 'none'); })()

steps.name: the header's user button leads to the Settings menu
steps.script: const u = document.querySelector('.headerUserButton'); if (u) u.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2500)); return location.hash;

steps.name: a typed locked URL
steps.script: location.hash = '#/userprofile'; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000)); return location.hash;

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
